technology_name: A METHOD FOR FABRICATION OF PRISTINE VANADIUM MONOCARBIDE QUANTUM DOTS FOR REDUCTION OF NITROBENZENE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Industrial chemical separation steps face steep energy barriers and low catalytic conversions when striving to reduce toxic nitrobenzene compounds without generating harmful secondary by-products.
description: A high-yield chemical synthesis methodology to produce uniform vanadium monocarbide quantum dots ($VC\ QDs$) by exposing a bulk vanadium precursor to a $750^\circ\text{C}$ thermal profile, followed by ultra-fast cooling within 100 milliseconds and an acetone bath sonication step to isolate unaggregated crystalline dots.
applications: Industrial nitrobenzene effluent treatment, fine chemical manufacturing catalysts, pharmaceutical intermediate processing, and advanced environmental analytical assays.
secondary_sector: Water, Environment & Waste Management, Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care
